text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm landing a change to switch our Envoy configmaps to immutable in prod overlay to enable atomic hot-reloads. Planning: terraform will create configmap with a suffix hash and set annotation `envoy.hot_reload=true`, deployment will be updated to point to the new name via overlay patch. Want to run the plan here before I open the PR.

Maria: Quick q — immutable means we have to create a new name on every change, right? how are we planning to switch pods without downtime? :eyes:

Ben: Correct. Pattern: create new ConfigMap with name like `envoy-config-<hash>`, update Deployment env var or volumeRef to that name, then rollout. Envoy sidecar picks up annotation and triggers config reload. Example k8s patch (staging overlay):

```
# kustomize patch
patchesJson6902:
- target:
    group: apps
    version: v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: envoy-proxy
  path: patch-envoy-config.yaml
```

patch-envoy-config.yaml snippet:
```
- op: replace
  path: /spec/template/spec/volumes/0/configMap/name
  value: envoy-config-<hash>
```

Alex: Terraform side (WIP) — using `kubernetes_manifest` to create the immutable configmap. Plan shows creation + deployment update. snippet from `terraform plan`:

```
+ kubernetes_manifest.envoy_config
    metadata:
      name: "envoy-config-86b4a"
    immutable: true
    data: {...}
+ kubernetes_deployment.envoy
    spec.template.spec.volumes[0].configMap.name: "envoy-config-1f3c" => "envoy-config-86b4a"
```

Raj: Two gating questions: 1) secrets — some envoy listeners reference TLS secrets. Are we rotating those too or reusing existing secrets? 2) rollbacks — if reload fails, how do we revert to previous config without manual edits?

Ben: For TLS we keep the same Secret resource (not immutable). ConfigMap only contains bootstrap and route config. TLS stays as before so no cert churn. For rollback we rely on k8s rollout revert and keeping last-known-good configmap around for N hours before GC. We'll add an annotation `config.redwood/previous: envoy-config-1f3c` to help automation.

Elaine: From release gating perspective — let's require: canary in staging for 30m with zero 5xx and latency SLOs within 5% before promoting to prod. Also add automatic fallback window (10m) in the rollout job so it reverts to previous deployment if healthchecks fail.

Alex: Sounds good. One more thing: do we need to encrypt the configmap data at rest? it's not secret data but some internal IPs — ops asked to enable SSE for S3-backed store. Thoughts?

Maria: If it's non-secret, fine. But if it contains service tokens we should move those to Secrets + KMS. Can we add a quick grep in CI to detect tokens?

Ben: I'll add a lint step to the kustomize pipeline that rejects `data` fields with `token|secret` patterns. And set S3 server-side encryption on the artifact bucket — I'll open the PR.

deploy-bot: Started terraform plan for `envoy-config-immutable` branch at 1769998955 — plan shows 2 adds, 1 update.

sre-bot: FYI: scheduling a small canary window on `staging` cluster at 1769998967. Health-check window = 30m.

Alex: I'll open the PR now with the terraform + kustomize patches and add the gating checklist (staging canary 30m, revert window 10m, keep previous config for 24h). Ping me for reviews.

Maria: Reviewing in a bit. If you can include the rollback runbook steps in the PR description that's super helpful. :thumbsup:

Ben: I'll add the lint and the S3 SSE config in separate PR linked from this one.

Raj: I'll coordinate with infra on the GC job for old configmaps — set to 24h TTL after successful promotion.

Alex: Thanks all — merging this plan into my branch. Will post PR link once ready.
